comments.author: Schaf-Unschaf
comments.body:
I'm always wondering.. where do the textures come from?
I can model but doing anything related to textures is way beyond me.

replies.author: zenmatrix83
replies.body:
you can do pbr textures in blender, substance 3d from adobe is a good paid one, I made my own pbr tool. its node based meaning the are procedural, but you can also do painting or a mixture with layers.

  
[https://www.adobe.com/learn/substance-3d-designer/web/the-pbr-guide-part-2](https://www.adobe.com/learn/substance-3d-designer/web/the-pbr-guide-part-2)

replies.author: SeasawPhilosopher
replies.body: I’m using Claude with Substance with great results but curious about what you built. How does it compare for you and is it producing better results or simply free and better integrated into your workflow. Do you have deep experience with rendering and materials or were you able to work with Claude and figure out how to build it?

replies.author: zenmatrix83
replies.body:
I took all of the apps needed in a general 3d asset pipeline, gathered all the features that make them good, and are trying to make my own . blender is awesome but it ui is bloated and I never really liked it. each app I have focuses on one part, and you switch to another app easierly as the all use the same file. each app has its own mcp server and they are designed so its easier for claude to go through and use these along with claude skills. this way claude can use computer use or mcp servers and I can work along with it as well.  I'm integrating git into it so we can version the underlying files and work on similar things at the same time. Part of it is blender just has too much in one app for me, part of its cost, part of its just experimenting. 

|App|Replaces|What it does|
|:-|:-|:-|
|Sketch|Photoshop, Krita|Paints concept art, matte paintings, and paint-overs on 3D renders|
|Board|PureRef|Collects and arranges reference; boards also open as a panel in every other app|
|Model|Maya, 3ds Max, Blender|Full 3D app for modeling, layout, cameras, and shots. The hub of the suite|
|Sculpt|ZBrush, Blender sculpt mode|Sculpts high-detail shapes up to 1 billion polygons|
|Topo|TopoGun, Maya Quad Draw, RetopoFlow, RizomUV|Rebuilds clean low-poly meshes, then unwraps and packs UVs|
|Paint|Substance 3D Painter|Paints textures right on the model with layers, masks, and smart materials|
|Graph|Substance 3D Designer|Builds procedural materials and textures with node graphs|
|Bake|Marmoset Toolbag|Bakes maps, does look dev, and makes portfolio renders and turntables|
|Animate|Maya, MotionBuilder, Blender|Rigs, animates, and cleans up motion capture|
|Flow|Houdini|Builds procedural models and runs simulations and effects|
|Render|Arnold, V-Ray, Redshift, RenderMan, Cycles, Eevee|One renderer with realtime, GPU, and film-quality modes|

comments.author: Disastrous-Round-150
comments.body: Did you use 3d software for that? I'm pretty sure AI could do that 100% procedural.

replies.author: zenmatrix83
replies.body: its a mix of procedural generated with node based creation , but also llm driving an mcp server, and some computer use. you can't see it because reddit compresses image too much but there are pbr textures with wear and rust and other things. I can hand model stuff in blender if needed, but this was 100% just claude using my tools and improving them while I gave it this result.
